mapper.select: WITH l AS ( SELECT d.district_key, d.municipality_code, coalesce(d.name_en, x.name_en) AS name, x.name_ar, (s.in_scope IS DISTINCT FROM false) AS in_scope, s.score_existing, s.score_current, s.score_target, s.parks, s.park_area_ha, s.park_gap_ha, s.is_sample, s.source_as_of FROM stat.stat_district_liveability s JOIN stat.dim_district x ON x.code = s.district_code JOIN theme.sp_district d ON d.municipality_code = upper(x.municipality) AND d.district_id = x.makani_district_id ), r AS ( SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN in_scope THEN rank() OVER (PARTITION BY in_scope ORDER BY score_current DESC) END AS rk, CASE WHEN in_scope THEN rank() OVER (PARTITION BY in_scope, municipality_code ORDER BY score_current DESC) END AS muni_rk, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_scope) OVER () AS scope_n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE in_scope) OVER (PARTITION BY municipality_code) AS muni_scope_n FROM l ) SELECT district_key AS "key", name AS "name", name_ar AS "nameAr", municipality_code AS "municipalityCode", in_scope AS "inScope", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_existing END AS "existing", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_current END AS "pipeline", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN score_target END AS "target", CASE WHEN in_scope THEN round(score_target - score_current, 2) END AS "gap", rk AS "rank", scope_n AS "rankOf", muni_rk AS "muniRank", muni_scope_n AS "muniRankOf", parks AS "parks", park_area_ha AS "parkAreaHa", park_gap_ha AS "parkGapHa", is_sample AS "sample", to_char(source_as_of, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "asOf" FROM r WHERE true AND municipality_code = #{municipality} AND district_key = #{district} ORDER BY in_scope DESC, score_current DESC NULLS LAST, name
